'''Golan Arms''' was a weapons manufacturing company, producer of such weapons as the [[FC-1 flechette launcher/Legends|FC-1 flechette launcher]] and the [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9]].

An athletics division of Golan Arms known as [[GolanGear]] produced [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]] equipment.<ref name="blog">{{Blog|caledre25|23|Endnotes For Fists Of Ion: Memoirs Of A Champion Shockboxer by Lobar Aybock, Chapter VII: Hard Raine}}</ref>

They also built heavily-armed [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] that were deployed throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[VenteX Construction Yards/Legends|VenteX Construction Yards]] was a subdivision of Golan Arms Construction Corporation.

Golan Arms was a top artillery manufacturer for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] but fell out of favor of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army's]] bureaucracy. On the brink of failure, they would soon join the Rebel Alliance. This led the company to become one of the biggest contributors to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] military forces.<ref name="EGWT" />
